# DB Tools Load Recordset From File.vi

![DB Tools Load Recordset From File.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/DB-UTIL-08.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Loads a recordset from a file and returns a recordset reference that identifies this recordset. You can retrieve data from this recordset like any other recordset, but some properties might not be available on this recordset.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

| file name `file_name` | `path` | Recommended | Not specified | file name specifies the file path to the file from which you want to read the data. |
